notes.title: Puppy Pipy will finish early access and launch in early 2025!
notes.notes:
Hi Dog lovers! 
Puppy Pipy will finish early access and launch in early 2025!
We add a lot of strange mechanical puzzle in chapter three and four.
We are woking on polishing chapter three and design levels in chapter four recently.
By the way, there will be a lot of cute dogs join Puppy Pipy as NPC. 

They are Baybay, SiobyZhang and Shiba.

notes.title: Early Access version 0.54 Update
notes.notes:
Hi All Dog Lovers,
Thank you for playing Puppy Pipy!
We made following Update:
- Resolution is changeable in options menu.
- Increased loading speed when changing scene.
- Better control and time scale when hit enemy.
- New keyboard icons.
- Enter button has same function as Space button. (Jump, Confirm)
- Full heart recovery when fail in the boss fight.
- Fix animation when touching ground after attack in the air. 

We will add Japanese, French and Spanish in next update!
Here is a hint for you: Beat chapter one in 6 minutes is possible if you use poop smartly. 
Have a good time with Pipy.
